content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IPC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: IPC Plumber Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Plumber: 10th pass with 2 years of working experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IPC Plumber Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) Recruitment 2026 is Plumber. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Plumber post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Plumber post at the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Plumber post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard and possess 2 years of working experience in the relevant field to be eligible for the Plumber position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Plumber position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Plumber post will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Plumber post is scheduled for 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the reporting time for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report for the Walk-in Interview between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Plumber post?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for specific age limit details for the Plumber post.
